subject: MAP cadence replan — slot compression & risk ledger
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP cadence replan — slot compression & risk ledger

Sara —

Quick update from our side after the week of testing: the current MAP milestones are drifting primarily because of extended security scans and a second-round procurement review at Acme. We reviewed options with infra and product and propose a compacted MAP to keep the target close date viable while addressing audit requests.

Proposal (high level):
- Re-baseline the MAP with compressed evaluation windows (reduce full-eval from 7 days to 4 days, run parallel subset tests).
- Create a single consolidated risk ledger identifying blockers, owners, and mitigation ETA (attached: risk_ledger_v3.xlsx).
- Canary plan: run a limited production canary on an isolated pool for 48–72 hours before full cutover.

Asks of Acme:
1) Confirm that procurement can accept an accelerated PO window (we need PO in hand no later than 2027-09-10 to keep target).
2) Share any priority compliance artifacts that remain outstanding (we received the CC/IT notes but not the vendor intake form).

I'll loop in Connor for the concrete timeline suggestion and Laura for customer success coordination. If this compression is acceptable we will circulate a revised MAP and an escalation note for your execs.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: risk_ledger_v3.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 42 KB)]

From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <procure@acme.com>
Date: Sun, 29 Aug 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP cadence replan — slot compression & risk ledger

Hi Hannah —

Appreciate the heads up and the ledger. Procurement is on an internal review today; my immediate blocker is that our legal/compliance team needs the vendor intake packet filled before they can greenlight the expedited PO. I pulled our vendor intake form and attached it — please have your operations team complete the standard fields.

Notes from my side:
- We can try to accelerate the PO but cannot commit to a date earlier than 2027-09-12 until legal clears.
- Security scans on our side are still queued; estimated completion is 2027-09-08 but could slip.

If you can show a revised MAP with condensed milestones and the canary window defined, I can present to legal and procurement this week.

Sara Jenkins
Director, AI Platforms — Acme Corp
[sara.jenkins@acme.com]
[Attachment: acme_vendor_intake.pdf (PDF, 130 KB)]

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>, Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP cadence replan — slot compression & risk ledger

Thanks Sara — and thanks Hannah for the ledger.

I sketched a pragmatic reprofile that keeps the same target quarter but shortens the middle evaluation windows by running the following in parallel:
- Week A (2027-09-05 to 2027-09-08): Security scan verification (Acme), parallel smoke tests (Redwood).
- Week B (2027-09-09 to 2027-09-12): Limited canary (1 node, isolated tenant) + performance regression spot checks.
- Week C (2027-09-13 to 2027-09-15): Expanded canary + cutover prep; PO needed by 09-12 for smooth rollout.

Mitigations for the usual slip causes:
- Procurement lag: accept a soft-start where we enable non-production accounts and begin training prior to PO finalization.
- Security artifacts: accept incremental evidence—if legal accepts staged deliverables we can unblock earlier.
- Resource contention: we will reserve a dedicated canary pool for Acme (no sharing) to keep variability low.

I attached a quick timeline spreadsheet and highlighted the points where an exec sync is advisable. If procurement can confirm a PO commitment window (soft or hard) we can lock dates.

—Connor
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: timeline_proposal_v1.xlsx (Excel, 28 KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP cadence replan — slot compression & risk ledger

Quick escalation note from my side — flagged to PM and finance: if the PO moves past 2027-09-12 we expose ourselves to an increased chance of a quarter-close delay and potential SLA credit triggers tied to the committed block. Two immediate asks:
1) Please confirm whether Acme would accept a staged contract (commit to license count, finalize billing after PO) — this would materially reduce schedule risk.
2) Internally, we should prepare fallback routing to a smaller, quantized model for the canary in case resource availability is constrained. Connor, can you confirm performance delta for the quantized variant?

I'm scheduling a 30-min exec sync for 2027-09-01 09:00 PT to surface the risk ledger and confirm decision points; invite will follow. We should be prepared to move to the fallback if procurement cannot meet the soft-date.

Rishi Malhotra
Director, Customer Success Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@acme.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP cadence replan — slot compression & risk ledger

Sara / team —

Thanks for the quick turn. Summary and agreed next steps from Redwood:
- Revised MAP: attached (revised_map_20270831.xlsx) with compressed evaluation windows and explicit owner for every risk in the ledger.
- Procurement ask: target PO by 2027-09-12 (soft); legal incremental evidence to be accepted by 2027-09-08 to stay on compressed path.
- Canary: scheduled 2027-09-09 to 2027-09-11, isolated tenant.
- Escalation: Rishi filed an internal escalation note and scheduled a 2027-09-01 exec sync to confirm fallback options.

Action items (owners):
- Acme: return completed vendor intake (Sara) — due 2027-08-31 EOD.
- Redwood Ops: finalize canary pool and provide runbook (Connor) — due 2027-09-02.
- Redwood CS: prepare staged enablement plan for non-production onboarding if procurement delays (Laura) — due 2027-09-03.
- Redwood Finance/Legal: evaluate staged-contract option (Rishi) — internal due 2027-09-02.

I'll follow up with the revised MAP and the escalation note post the 2027-09-01 exec sync. If procurement or legal confirms earlier commitment we can further tighten the windows.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: revised_map_20270831.xlsx (Excel, 64 KB)]
